endpoint.source: verified project IAM compute catalog public endpoint for explicitly selected pool/region; exact scoped overrides supported
endpoint.microversion: flavors fixed2.93; keypairs default2.35, create/list explicit version2.1..2.93 with field/permission checks

request.scope: immutable explicit project/location; IAMProject only, no account fallback
request.identity: exact ID/name/ref with matching view, endpoint, generation, kind and owner parent; no name lookup to prove unknown mutation authorship
request.parameters: flavors minDisk/minRam/changes-since/is_public/sort single or repeated pairs; pagination limit/marker internally bounded; keypairs user_id explicit named-owner or separate Current API; source-only keypair name/type/public_key/user_id body
request.keypair_versions: type requires2.2; explicit owner requires2.10; limit/marker requires2.35; create from2.92 requires public_key and never implicitly generates private key
request.ref_ownership: explicit named filters or returned user_id yield keypair_user parent; absent owner in Current listing yields distinct keypair_current_user parent. Named/Current refs cannot cross APIs before I/O.

response.field_mapping: all pinned fields; Integer/Number preserve precision, legacy swap integer/string/empty accepted; optional values retain absence, nullable flavor description/keypair timestamps retain explicit null; Nova timestamps normalize UTC
response.identity_validation: nonempty matching source ID/name; explicit owner filter must match returned owner; provider ref discarded; no foreign reference adoption

errors.400: provider_error, with no opaque message classification
errors.429: rate_limited for reads; unknown mutation outcome unless rejection proved
errors.malformed_accepted_response: protocol_error and accepted Receipt; trustworthy exact key identity retained before sensitive decode failure
errors.message: fixed SDK error text; opaque provider payload discarded

retry: bounded safe reads; mutations exactly one attempt

pagination.shape: flavors link marker; keypairs bounded limit/last-name marker from2.35, pre2.35 fixed response replay cursor
pagination.cursor_binding: operation/contract/scope/generation/endpoint/filter/current-vs-named owner fingerprint; no next-link URL traversal; original filters preserved

recovery.availability: no root Handle/Resume for flavor/keypair; exact key Get observes current data, never replays or adopts an unknown mutation

current_principal_limitation: Current calls are relative to the selected authenticated subject. An owner-less Current ref does not prove original principal identity after credential replacement; returned user_id produces a named-owner ref. No absolute-owner or changed-principal recovery claim.
timeout: CallTimeout; one CollectionTimeout over paginated reads
